content:
Here's a funny anime-related tidbit: In the popular anime "One Punch Man," the protagonist Saitama is so incredibly strong that he can defeat any enemy with a single punch. However, this makes him incredibly bored because no fight is ever challenging. He's essentially a superhero who is depressed because he's TOO powerful, which creates a hilarious and ironic situation. His facial expressions, which are often comically plain and unimpressed despite saving the world, add to the humor of the series.
